description: After a member declines the start (or the host cancels / times out / loses the room), the host now aborts the attempt: flow progress op5 returns the relay room to the lobby so the start button recovers, pending start retries and per-seat ack bookkeeping are cleared. Members holding a stale invite get it dismissed automatically when the room rolls back. Follow-up sweep fix: if the abort's op5 was lost (the disconnect abort path), the host self-heals an orphaned setup-phase room from the menu once back with no start in flight. Shared Online files (NetSession.h, NetProtocol.h, FlowSession.inl) synced whole from the PC working tree; LawnApp.cpp/OnlineGame.cpp/LawnApp.h fork replayed per hunk. FlowSession.inl logs via NetworkLog instead of TodLog (no Tod layer in this port).
